text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Hrm... That didn't go how I expected...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I feel like I can't quite catch up to the
vision I
have for myself in my head...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I know I have to do better somehow,
but... I don't
know how.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
...If you say so. I won't argue with you,
but I don't
know...
choice_data_list: 悪いところばかりじゃなかった
できることをコツコツとやるしかない
choice_data_list_en: All we can do is tackle what we can, step by step.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Haha... I guess we have to. Moping
around
certainly isn't going to get me
anywhere.
choice_data_list: 長所を伸ばしていこう
choice_data_list_en: Let's focus on building your strengths.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Okay. Let's work on improving what I'm
good at
even more. We'll use that to win
next time.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I guess you're right. I'm at a loss, but if I
use that
as an excuse not to do
anything, I'm just gonna
keep getting
the same results.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
It's like I'm tofu and you're the tofu
press. Keep
putting on the pressure with
training until we have
ourselves some
grade A tofu.
